usedFor: Amazon Seller Central records orders and refunds, and Brevo stores the buyers as contacts through “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A buyer who already exists gets updated instead of duplicated, so your Brevo list stays clean.

watchOut: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central is polling, so new buyers reach Brevo after a scheduled check.
